name: The Victorian Cottage
body:
THE ONLY PART OF BANSHEE HAVEN THAT LOOKS LIKE A HOUSE. Rounded roof, warm timber, climbing ivy — a building that looks GROWN rather than built, sitting at the surface like the right breast crowning above a neckline.

THIS IS WHERE YOU ENTER, AND IT IS ELSPETH'S. Foyer, intimate kitchen, the Chapel living room, the pantry. Everything warm, everything bread-scented, everything designed to make a girl feel HELD BEFORE THE DESCENT BEGINS.

THE STAIRCASE DOWN IS AT THE BACK, TUCKED BEHIND THE CHAPEL. Not hidden — this house does not lie — but placed so that a girl has to pass through Elspeth's care before she reaches Bell's depth. By design. Always by design.
